To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) several information systems exist that automate individual systematic review tasks; (2) these systems have not yet been integrated into one single workflow; (3) there are several gaps in automation that need to be filled to achieve a fully automated systematic review process; and (4) there is a need for a new systematic review workflow that integrates the individual tasks of the systematic reviews.

the state of the systematic review automation technologies is that there are several systems that can be combined in order to support the automation of each step of the systematic review, with the exception of the synthesis and reporting steps.
the automation of systematic reviews is possible and is already in place for several of the tasks involved, but that there are still several tasks that need further development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of information systems for systematic reviews, and the automation of individual tasks in systematic reviews.
the automation of systematic review tasks.
the design, development and evaluation of information systems that support or facilitate the production of systematic reviews.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the automation of systematic review tasks is a work in progress and that the field is still far from achieving the goal of a fully automated systematic review process.
the automation of systematic review is still a long way from being a reality.
the automation of the systematic review process is possible and that the automation will have a major effect on the systematic review workflow.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the current state of the art in information systems for supporting systematic reviews is not sufficient to support the full process of systematic review.
there are many tools available for each step of the systematic review and that the next step in the development of these tools is to integrate them into a single system.
the automation of each task of the systematic review process will lead to the automation of the whole systematic review process.

the automation of systematic reviews is possible.
